title: Audit and archive 9 verified priority landed cloud task records
goal: Prove git commit ancestry on origin/main, run each task's acceptance command on current HEAD, and archive 9 verified priority cloud task records (T-CLAUDE-409..413, T-ANTIGRAVITY-5, T-ANTIGRAVITY-7, T-CODEXEMBEDORDER-1, T-CODEXGAWDACP-1) into .agents/tasks/done/ while leaving T-CLAUDEPORTBLOCKS-1 open pending a host with a routed non-loopback LAN IPv4 interface.
notes: Archives the 9 priority cloud tasks whose implementation commits are proven ancestors of origin/main and whose accept.cmd passed on current Linux x86_64 HEAD. T-CLAUDEPORTBLOCKS-1 remains in .agents/tasks/ because its accept.cmd runs host_only_privacy and peer_channel_hub, which require a routed private/link-local non-loopback IPv4 interface absent on this loopback-only cloud VM.

reuse.searched: tests/task_records.rs, tests/task_record_schema_debt.json, .agents/tasks/done/T-AG3DONEDEBT-6.json in Susi Core, and susi-dev-workflow task queue contracts in Susi Commercial Apps
reuse.reason: Reuses the existing susi.task_record/v1 closed-task schema and task_records validation harness without adding code or dependencies.
